title: Who am I?
text:
About Me

“Religion is an insult to human dignity. Without it you would have good people doing good things and evil people doing evil things. But for good people to do evil things, that takes religion.”
– Steven Weinberg

I was born in a cult (Dawoodi Bohra). More than 10 years ago, I moved away from that bullshit because it was both unconvincing and in opposition to my morals (and certainly yours). Since then, I’ve developed a passion for science, especially biology, and have been lucky enough to turn this passion into my career. Recently, I moved from France to the US to develop my research skills.
In my free time, I enjoy reading Lovecraftian stories, playing video games (please play Expedition 33), and lamenting the lack of good cheese.

title: Projects
text:
A few things I’ve built and tinkered with, mostly small Python tools written for specific real-world needs. All code is on GitHub.


check_SIGVILLE_priority_zone

Identifies whether a list of addresses falls within a “Quartier Prioritaire” (priority urban zone), using France’s official SIG Ville API.


Python



equilibrated_groups_of_students

Distributes a list of students of varying levels into balanced groups of similar size and skill level, with each group assigned a volunteer.
